data.name: Adanes
data.description:
Early life: Adanes Xaiver Cortes (or simply known as Adanes Cortes) was born on December 14, 2008 to Mexican-born parents and was raised in Charlotte, North Carolina. Growing up, he was somewhat of a big fan of animations, especially cartoons and object shows, music, especially around the 2010's on the radio, which he is nostalgic about, and mobile/video games such as Angry Birds, Super Mario, Roblox, Minecraft. As for animation, he was a big fan of the Pink Panther, Spongebob Squarepants, The Fairy Oddparents, Adventure Time, Regular Show, Veggietales, you know the rest. As for internet animation, he was also into Eddsworld, object shows such as Battle for Dream Island, Inanimate Insanity, Brawl of the Objects, Object Overload, many others, and possibly animator Vivziepop. He also acknowledges adult animated shows and pilots growing up such as The Simpsons, Family Guy, South Park, American Dad, The Cleveland Show, Rick and Morty, Hazbin Hotel, and Helluva Boss (the last two as he reached into his early 10s).

Within family: After his great grandmother passed away, Adanes would notice that his father started to constantly argue with his stepmother, who is Dominican. His father unfortunately didn't grieve properly, so that was why. Eventually they separated and filed a divorce when Adanes was 16. He was somewhat overweight until age 16 to 17 where he started to exercise regularly.

For music, Adanes is nostalgic about top 40 and urban radio and music in the 2010s, though of course there were some that were bound to be cheesy and bad. Adanes was exposed to his mother's favorite music such as early 2000's r&b / hip hop and bands such as Red Hot Chili Peppers (prior to finding out what the lead singer, Anthony Keidis, did to a teenage girl, as well as couple diabolical events and couple allegations or accusations on other band members on Wikipedia at age 15, he used to adore the band very much). He was also exposed to his father's music taste was a combination of crunk, dirty rap, 90's west coast rap, Chicano rap, gangsta rap, and chopped and screwed. While in his pre to early teens, he was exposed to artists such as Boris Brejcha, Stephan Bodzin, Brian Eno, Aphex Twin, Tale of Us, Franky Wah, Joris Voorn, Richie Blacker, Moby, 747 (Canadian melodic acid techno artist), Troma & PERS1 (French melodic acid techno duo), Bastinov, Charles Webster, The Advent, James Shinra, Versalife, and Gregor Tresher via the internet, recommendations, and their back catalogue
-
Career:
At age 14, Adanes dropped his first extended play on SoundCloud, the first track, a Progressive Breaks track inspired by the aforementioned Franky Wah's 'You Don't Know' and the second and last being an ambient track. Of course the EP gotten very few listens upon it's release on SoundCloud, which is normal for beginner music artists. As he continued to release new material on SoundCloud, Newgrounds and Audiomack, his popularity started to gradually increase. However, those following and talking about Adanes were all coming from outside the United States rather than within (state-wise), with a very few coming from Canada and the U.S. territory of Puerto Rico, which he didn't mind.

Just before he turned 16, Adanes was finally able to learn how to officially release music independently via TuneCore. He released his first official single at the start of 2025, which was a melodic techno track reminiscent of the mid-2010's (artists like Tales of Us, Mind Against, and Stephan Bodzin, the former both before they became well known outside listeners and fans of the genre), under his own releasing imprint AXC Productions. It performed somewhat low in the Australia Dance (ARIA), UK Dance (OCC), and Belgium Dance (Ultratop, both Flanders and Wallonia) charts. At first glance, it seems like a flop in the charts, keep in mind however his international popularity was still steadily growing.

About a few tracks later and a several weeks after he turned 17, Adanes released another melodic Progressive Breaks track "Paths", which is also inspired by the works of the aforementioned Stephan Bodzin (especially the synths and bassline) and became a successful sleeper hit by next year (2027) when he was in second semester of his senior year, charting in all countries except the U.S., eventually reaching the top 10 in Sweden, New Zealand, Belgium, Austria, Poland, Finland, the Global 200 chart, the UK, and number 1 in Ireland. The success led to a distribution deal with Virgin Music Group, continuing his new found attention and expressing what he went through growing up.

A couple years later (2029), Adanes would start to work on his debut album 'From Myself', which about the struggles and hardships he went through, hope, and identity. The album combined and used elements of a lot of Dance and Electronic music genres such as Progressive Breaks, Ambient music, Downtempo, Ambient house/techno, Melodic techno, Microhouse, Deep breaks, Piano breaks (late 80's to early 90's upbeat to be exact), Dub techno, Minimal techno, Techno, Afro House, IDM/Braindance, Alternate/Indie Dance, Neo Trance, House music, chill-out, UK Garage, (Melodic) acid techno, and (deep/melodic) Electro funk. The tracklist would go from chill, deep to progressive, with Adanes making sure the transitions would go smoothly and not so sudden. Upon it's release, the album received critical acclaim from both critics and fans alike, of course there was bound to be few negative reviews here and there, thankfully he accepts criticism. Sales of the album became gradually successful, charting in countries that has official music charts (most of which were in top 20 or 10, reaching number 1 in Ireland, Argentina, Italy, New Zealand, and Australia), excluding the United States.

Up until the release of his debut album, Adanes hadn't revealed what he looks like, where he was raised, and his middle surname other than just 'United States', his first and last name, and his silhouette. This is confirmed in the cover art, the CD booklet, and the vinyl/LP release for the album. In the vinyl/LP release, there's a copy of a pamphlet insert he made when he was 15 called 'A Thing (or more) From Adanes' which gives more information on his childhood, where he was raised, some of his past interests, and a couple motivational quotes.

Adanes is currently specializing (or has specialized) in music genres such as Breaks/Breakbeat (Deep, Progressive, and Piano), Ambient music, Downtempo, Ambient house/techno, Melodic techno, Microhouse, Jazz house, Dub techno, Minimal techno, Techno, Afro House, Intelligent dance music (IDM)/Braindance, Alternate/Indie Dance, Neo Trance, House music, UK Garage, chill-out, Detroit techno, and (deep/melodic) Electro funk, sometimes being described as hybrid-genre. Most of his works are instrumental as he doesn't collaborate with other musicians very often, though he did a collaborative track with some influential electronic music duos from England, one with Underworld and an ambient house track with The Orb for his aforementioned debut album "From Myself" and two non-album tracks/singles with Orbital and Leftfield respectively
-
Personality: Adanes is shy, introverted and nervous (when it comes to attractive looking women), happy, honest, and stays somewhat fit. He doesn't do drugs, drink alcohol or even smoke. He is also been able to do live PA performances instead of just turntables, bringing not just his music, but also tracks that have influenced his sound to the stage using drum machines and synthesizers. He is said to be working on his second studio album. Adanes tends to travel a lot, thankfully he doesn't travel all the time incase of low self esteem or emergency within his family. He likes art and is inspired by classic rock/metal / soul / funk / folk music (for that only Sixto Rodriguez, Nick Drake, and Bob Dylan). Adanes can be a bit of a nerd, especially about animation and music. His music focuses on and alludes to the themes of hope(fulness), hardships, and identity, though has also made melancholic and depressing sounding music, some of which can make a person cry if at their lowest point. He is against corruption and greed in the music industry and everything in general. He currently reside in Pineville, North Carolina, living alone in modular house he brought, though he has plans to move outside the United States to somewhere in Cabo Verde. Adanes may use social media, but not very excessively as he have a life outside of that.
